description: This file implements a test utility class 'TestFrameSequence' for constructing and serializing HTTP/2 frames, used for testing the quiche HTTP/2 adapter. It includes methods for creating various frame types such as DATA, SETTINGS, HEADERS, PING, GOAWAY, and more, and serializes them into a byte string.

classes.name: TestFrameSequence
classes.description: A utility class for constructing and serializing sequences of HTTP/2 frames for testing purposes.

methods.name: ToHeaders
methods.description: Converts a span of header key-value pairs into a vector of Header objects.

methods.name: ClientPreface
methods.description: Adds the client connection preface and applies settings.

methods.name: ServerPreface
methods.description: Adds the server preface with settings.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Creates a DATA frame with specified stream ID, payload, fin flag, and optional padding.

methods.name: RstStream
methods.description: Creates a RST_STREAM frame with stream ID and error code.

methods.name: Settings
methods.description: Creates a SETTINGS frame with provided settings.

methods.name: SettingsAck
methods.description: Creates a SETTINGS frame with ACK flag.

methods.name: PushPromise
methods.description: Creates a PUSH_PROMISE frame with headers.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Creates a PING frame with specified ID.

methods.name: PingAck
methods.description: Creates a PING frame with ACK flag.

methods.name: GoAway
methods.description: Creates a GOAWAY frame with last good stream ID, error, and payload.

methods.name: Headers
methods.description: Creates HEADERS frames, with support for continuation and encoding.

methods.name: Metadata
methods.description: Creates METADATA frames, possibly split into multiple frames.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the sequence of frames into a string.
